info.title: ACCOUNT API
info.description: These set of APIs interact with the BaaS vendor (unit) to create bank accounts, facilitate payment and card transactions.

patch.description: Updates the member account status in order to close, freeze, or activate the account.

400.description:
Bad request.
- GBL-157: Status cannot be updated as the account is not Active or Closed
- GBL-161: Member account status cannot be updated for the requested product
- GBL-179: Member Account is already in the requested status
- GBL-258: Member account cannot be closed with a negative balance
- GBL-259: Member account cannot be closed with an active Investment account
- GBL-260: Member must authorize the account to be closed since this is a member-owned account
- GBL-261: Invalid product configuration
- GBL-271: Member account cannot be closed as member does not have a linked external account
- GBL-375: Investment account cannot be closed while positions or cash balance remain

clientMemberId.description: Unique client-side identifier for the member

name.description: The name of the client organization

idempotencyKey.description: Unique identifier that represents the operation

errorCode.description: The GBL error code that is populated when the exceptionSource is SYSTEM

exceptionSource.description: Characterizes the type of exception (JSON, SYSTEM, PARAMETER)

idempotency.description: Unique identifier that represents the operation

clientMemberId.description: Unique client-side identifier for the member

memberBankAccountId.description: Unique identifier of the bank account

statusReason.description: The reason for a particular status; Required when closing the account

memberAuthorized.description: Indicates whether member has authorized closure of the account; this is required when it is a member-owned account type, such as a Health Savings Account

memberAuthorizedDate.description: Date when the member has authorized closure of the account; this is required when it is a member-owned account type, such as a Health Savings Account
